summary: Liquid light engineering. A highly concentrated, weightless fluid that delivers a blinding, glass-like reflection.
description: Catch the high beams. This serum-like highlighter suspends ultra-fine pearlescent pigments in a clear base, creating a wet, high-shine finish that integrates seamlessly with the skin’s surface.
technical_overview: Offered at $30.0 for 15ml, this KoColor HIGHLIGHTER is expertly formulated with Isododecane, Mica, and Synthetic Fluorphlogopite. It delivers a high-fidelity Pearlescent Beam color profile (`#FFFDD0`) and leverages refractive optical clarity.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Tap a single drop onto the highest points of the cheekbones and blend immediately.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Mix a drop directly into your body lotion for a high-fidelity, all-over structural sheen.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Evaporative volatile carriers (Isododecane) ensure the liquid dries down fully, locking the pearls in place without tackiness.
